audit.whatIsWrong: The early-game text credited Nimble Fighter with tenacity and gave Crescent Strike a slow.
audit.why: Fizz's passive is unit-walking plus flat damage reduction; Crescent Strike applies Moonlight and reveals, with no slow in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: early rewritten around the flat damage reduction and Moonsilver Blade's third-strike cleave.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Lunar Rush reset was described loosely and wants.foe[0] said Crescent Strike roots.
audit.why: Crescent Strike (8/7.5/7/6.5/6) afflicts Moonlight; Lunar Rush (22/20/18/16/14) has NO cooldown when it dashes to a Moonlight target, so dodging the arc is what costs her the free dash. Nothing in her kit roots. Both Playful/Trickster and Chum the Waters ground, which shuts Lunar Rush off entirely.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries the real numbers and the grounding answer; wants.foe[0] now says Moonlight, not root.
